sections.Profile:
The "Surf Rider" pinball machine, released by Williams Manufacturing Company on May 14, 1956, is a four-player electro-mechanical game designed by Harry Williams, with artwork by George Molentin.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1956
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 4
- Tags: Water Sports, Good Times, Sports, Original Theme, Recreation, Surfing
